title: Tusken Chief
description: The tribe of Tusken Raiders that took in Boba Fett was led by the Tusken Chief. Fett defeated a Sand Ape that menaced a young Tusken and allowed the child to get the adulation of his tribe. The Chief understood what Fett had done, and shared water with him as a sign of respect. Unfortuantely, the Tusken Chief was killed on orders of the Pyke Syndicate.
